title: E-Commerce Platform
description: Full-stack e-commerce platform built with React, Node.js, and AWS services. Features include product catalog, shopping cart, payment processing with Stripe, and admin dashboard for inventory management.

title: Real-time Chat Application
description: Scalable real-time chat application using WebSocket technology. Supports room-based chatting, file sharing, and user authentication with JWT. Deployed on AWS EC2 with auto-scaling.

title: Data Analytics Dashboard
description: Interactive data analytics dashboard for business intelligence. Features real-time data visualization, custom report generation, and export capabilities. Built with Python backend and React frontend.
